stage.label: Speakers
stage.title: Which output drives what?

paragraphs.text: Tell uConsole what each output plays: a full-range speaker, a woofer, a mid, a tweeter or a subwoofer. The suggestion comes from the DSPi's filters and routing: check it and confirm it, or leave it for later.
The measurement and its safety checks take each output's role from here. An output with an active high-pass at 1 kHz or above is measured as a tweeter, whatever its role here.

stage.no_device: Connect your DSPi to set this up. You can also do it later in Settings › Speakers.
stage.confirmed: Confirmed. You can change it later in Settings › Speakers.
stage.later: Not sure yet? Choose Later: measuring and auto-tune ask for this before they start, and AI agents cannot measure until it is confirmed. It waits for you in Settings › Speakers.
